note: Retrieval test set: each question lists the WCAG 2.2 success criteria that answer it (any one counts as a hit). Written by the team from the WCAG 2.2 text; 20 English and 20 Chinese questions on the same topics.

questions.q: What contrast ratio does normal-sized text need?
Do prerecorded videos need captions?

Can a login ask people to solve a puzzle or remember a password?
Do images need a text alternative?
Must everything work with a keyboard only?
Can I use colour alone to show which form fields have errors?
How should a form tell people about an input error?
Is a time limit on a quiz allowed?
Can content flash several times per second?
Should a page have a descriptive title?
Does the keyboard focus need to be visible?
Can a sticky header cover the element that has focus?
Must content still work when zoomed to 400 percent on a narrow screen?
Should the language of the page be set in the code?
Can a form ask for the same information twice in one process?
Must a help link appear in the same place on every page?
Can actions require dragging, or must there be a single-pointer alternative?
Does auto-playing audio need a way to stop it?
Do link texts need to make sense out of context?
